name: Kindle Paperwhite
notes: Amazon User Guide, 2nd Edition, Product Specifications (printed page 50): 166.57 × 115.84 × 8.18 mm; use these rather than the rounded 167 × 116 × 8.2 mm catalog entry. Controls section (printed page 5) places the power button on the bottom edge. Retention remains a prototype assumption. Scan-informed update: approximately 9 mm corners and layered rear taper from PrintedForFun, https://www.printables.com/model/1699495-kindle-paperwhite-gen-10-tpu-bumper-and-3d-scan (CC BY-NC 4.0). Relative insets use the 2 mm scan outline as maximum, with depths scaled from 7.76 to the published 8.18 mm. The last measured outline is held to the rear for conservative clearance. See docs/kindle-paperwhite-gen-10-scan-analysis.md. Physical fit remains untested.
